review: First reasoned review of three PE samples; no malware execution or C2 retrieval

samples.identification: Native carrier with an embedded XWorm XClient; decrypted configuration says XWorm V5.6
evidence: Embedded managed PE begins at file offset 0x368d0. Native function 0x140017760 copies exactly 64000 embedded bytes from VA 0x1400380d0 and writes them to a destination assembled under Documents/diagnostics as audiodg.exe. The path feeds process-launch preparation at 0x140016f90.

IL entry point RVA 0x2704 copies the current executable to the configured install path, opens HKCU CurrentVersion/Run writable and calls RegistryKey.SetValue with that path. It also resolves SpecialFolder 7 (Startup), creates a .lnk through WScript.Shell, assigns its TargetPath and calls Save.

Configuration decoder RVA 0x4ce0 derives a 32-byte AES key from MD5 of a UTF-8 embedded seed, copying the digest at offsets 0 and 15. It decrypts Base64 with Rijndael ECB. Static reconstruction yielded XWorm V5.6, USB.exe, %LocalAppData%, winlogon, and a Pastebin raw rendezvous URL. The URL was not fetched.

Task handler RVA 0x3738 decrypts input, decodes UTF-8 and splits the packet. RunShell passes argument 1 to Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.Shell. StartDDos and StopDDos create or abort an attack worker.

Attack lambda RVA 0x4974 connects a TCP socket, sends an HTTP POST header advertising Content-length 5235, sleeps 2500 ms without a body and disposes the socket. The parent worker fans out threads. This is concrete remote tasking and resource-exhaustion behavior.

Third-party Ditekshen AsyncRAT's all-cnc alternative requires only three browser User-Agents and a POST line. ReversingLabs matches shared send/open-url/monitoring CIL. Neither establishes a second family. Sekoia's shared-string rule likewise cannot establish version 3.
changes: Add a notable, section-bounded embedded-XWorm vocabulary identity requiring DOS/CLR markers and four command tokens in .rdata.
Use that identity to suppress incorrect AsyncRAT and v3 attributions on native carriers. Retain client behavioral hostiles and generic HTTP/crypto/process observations.
Replace the redundant CAPE placeholder-description finding with independently established native family identity.

samples.identification: StormAttack service-DLL injector and packet-controlled DDoS module
evidence: Embedded PE at file offset 0x5060 is a native MFC DLL with StormAttack banners, STORM host-report format and matching packet handlers. These identify the module; the hostile verdict comes from the following code.

Outer function 0x401260 rewrites LanmanServer Parameters/ServiceDLL. Function 0x401150 creates a process, allocates remote memory, writes a DLL path, resolves LoadLibraryA and passes that address/path to CreateRemoteThread. Other reachable paths register Active Setup StubPath and delete the carrier via COMSPEC.
DLL function 0x1000228e calls WSASocketA(AF_INET, SOCK_RAW, IPPROTO_UDP), sets raw-header options and loops over twelve sendto calls per burst until a global stop flag is set.

DLL function 0x10006ac9 receives 0x528-byte records, copies them and dispatches the leading opcode. Task 1 selects flood routines; task 2 stops them; task 5 passes a record field to function 0x100067c2.
Function 0x100067c2 dynamically resolves URLDownloadToFileA, downloads the task-specified URL into a System-directory path and passes that same destination to CreateProcessA.
changes: no change; existing injector, persistence, flooding, tasking and identity findings are supported

samples.identification: Partly unpacked native autorun worm with Protected Storage credential theft
evidence: PE retains a UPX entry stub, large zero-filled regions, populated UPX sections, resolved pointer tables and runtime-specific installed paths. This resembles a partially unpacked memory artifact; UPX failure is not evidence of ransomware.

Counted byte-XOR routine 0x428653 is called with varying keys to reconstruct APIs, endpoints, registry paths and commands. Some strings in this artifact are already decoded. API-name observations and recovered code were considered separately.
Main routine 0x42b19d calls Virtual PC and VMware probes at 0x428492 and 0x42840d and returns early if either reports a guest. Otherwise it starts propagation and command/report workers.

Propagation routine 0x42a20c loops through drive letters, checks GetDriveType for removable media, copies the installed worm to the drive root, sets attributes and writes autorun.inf with an executable ShellExecute directive. The copy/configuration operations are reachable, not mere string references.

Function 0x42a4d4 resolves PStoreCreateInstance, enumerates types, subtypes and items, and invokes ReadItem through COM wrappers at 0x42b46c, 0x42b4a8, 0x42b532 and 0x42b4e7. It classifies and extracts saved-site and autocomplete credentials into a username/password report at 0x42a48e.

Worker 0x42aceb calls 0x42acc8 to acquire that report, incorporates the result into a transmission buffer and invokes HTTP sender 0x42964e. The sender formats a form-urlencoded POST and transmits the same local request buffer through Winsock.

Function 0x428aad constructs and writes Run entries, a service ImagePath and an HKCR exefile/shell/open/command wrapper preserving the victim executable arguments. The association wrapper prepends the installed worm.
changes: no change; existing propagation, credential acquisition, report/POST co-occurrence and association-wrapper findings are supported
limitations: Damaged/partly unpacked bytes do not establish successful execution of the supplied artifact. No WannaCry or other ransomware attribution is supported by the filename.

verification: Ran atomscan and cleave facts on each original sample; extracted and inspected embedded images using ILSpy, Ghidra and rizin.
Re-ran atomscan after changes and checked each sample retains at least two supported hostile findings.
Checked that AsyncRAT, v3 and the CAPE placeholder attributions are absent from both XWorm carrier and child.
Triage links were inaccessible through the web tool; sandbox scores and ensemble output were not used as proof.
